combustionVentType.sourceSpan: a shared B-vent up through the roof

ambientCo.sourceSpan: ambient CO in the room climbed to thirty-five ppm with both firing, that is over my threshold, I'm calling that a fail on ambient CO

venting.sourceSpan: I'm flagging venting as a warning too, it needs to be re-supported and fastened

naturalConditionSpillage.sourceSpan: no spillage under natural conditions, it only let go under worst case. So natural condition passes

worstCaseDepressurization.sourceSpan: I depressurized the house with the exhaust fans and the dryer running, got it to about minus fifty pascals

worstCaseSpillage.sourceSpan: the water heater spilled at the draft hood, sustained, did not clear. Worst case spillage is a fail

draftPressure.sourceSpan: Draft pressure on the furnace, once it was the only thing running, was adequate, good steady draft, that one passes

gasLeak.sourceSpan: There's a small leak at the range shutoff valve, the sniffer lit up on it, not huge but it's real, I'd call that a warning

moldMoisture.sourceSpan: Mold, asbestos, lead — none of that was in scope for this combustion visit, I didn't look at any of it today
